text:
[LTES.8.3.1] The conformance suite is the fixture corpus at
`specs/conformance/`, one directory per category, with the harness that runs
it beside them:

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `compiler/` | compile-time tests |
| `runtime/` | engine-semantic tests |
| `temporal/` | clock-driven behaviour |
| `adapter/` | adapter-contract conformance |
| `logical/` | truth-maintenance |
| `cross-tier/` | fact-flow rules |
| `harness/` | the driver the conformance tests run under |
